title: Switching between Activities very slow (background takes a second to refresh)
line: Switching activities no longer flashes a black desktop: the new wallpaper slides in over the old one.
explanation: When the activity changes, libplasma's ContainmentView hides the old desktop containment before the desktop shell's QML gets the new one. Desktop.qml then runs its switch animation, sliding the new containment in from the right while 'sliding out' the old one, which is already invisible, so the screen shows black until the new desktop has slid across. The change makes the old containment visible again at the start of the animation; the animation's last step already hides it.

commits.message:
desktoppackage: keep the old desktop visible while switching activities

The old activity's desktop is hidden as soon as the containment changes,
so the new one slid in over an empty black window. Show it again while
the switch animation runs, so the new desktop slides over the old one.

BUG: 476406
